cards.front: No importa cómo se lo digas a ella, le va a hacer daño.
cards.back: No matter how you tell her, it'll hurt.

cards.front: No importa cómo le des la noticia, le hará daño a ella.
cards.back: No matter how you break the news, she'll be hurt.

cards.front: No importa cómo se lo digas, estará decepcionado.
cards.back: No matter how you break it to him, he'll be disappointed.

cards.front: Por muy a menudo que él fuera a casa los fines de semana, seguía con morriña.
cards.back: No matter how often he went home at the weekends, he was still homesick.

cards.front: Por muy a menudo que se vieran, él aún la echaba de menos.
cards.back: No matter how often they saw each other, he still missed her.

cards.front: Por muy a menudo que estuvieran separados, él no podía acostumbrarse a ello. Aún le dolía.
cards.back: No matter how often they were apart, he couldn't get used to it. It still hurt.

cards.front: Por mucho dinero que gastara él, nunca era suficiente.
cards.back: No matter how much money he spent, it was never enough.

cards.front: Por mucho tiempo que pasasen separados, aún se echaban de menos.
cards.back: No matter how much time they spent apart, they still missed each other.

cards.front: Por mucha agua que bebiera él, aún tenía sed.
cards.back: No matter how much water he drank, he was still thirsty.

cards.front: No creo que lleguemos a un acuerdo nunca, por muchas veces que lo intentemos.
cards.back: I don't think we'll ever reach an agreement, no matter how many times we try.

cards.front: Siempre se echarán de menos, por mucha gente nueva que conozcan.
cards.back: They'll always miss each other, no matter how many new people they meet.

cards.front: No creo que vaya a estar a salvo al 100% nunca, por muchos guardaespaldas que contratemos.
cards.back: I don't think she'll ever be 100% safe, no matter how many bodyguards we hire.

cards.front: Por muy cuidadosamente que le des la noticia a ella, aún se disgustará.
cards.back: No matter how gently you break the news, she'll still be upset.

cards.front: Él nunca se sentía satisfecho, por muy rico que fuera.
cards.back: He never felt satisfied, no matter how rich he was.

cards.front: No importa lo pesado que sea él, tendrás que aguantarle.
cards.back: No matter how annoying he is, you'll have to put up with him.

cards.front: Digas lo que digas, ella no te perdonará.
cards.back: No matter what you say, she won't forgive you.

cards.front: Haga lo que haga él, no le voy a dar otra oportunidad.
cards.back: No matter what he does, I'm not going to give him another chance.

cards.front: Él ha quemado sus naves. La gente no va a darle otra oportunidad, intente lo que intente.
cards.back: He's burned his bridges. People aren't going to give him another chance, no matter what he tries.

cards.front: Elijas el destino que elijas, te lo pasarás de maravilla.
cards.back: No matter which destination you choose, you'll have a brilliant time.

cards.front: La empresa dará beneficios independientemente del producto que lancen.
cards.back: The company will turn over a profit, no matter which product they release.

cards.front: Las cosas no cambiarán independientemente de qué partido gane las elecciones.
cards.back: Things won't change no matter which party wins the election.

cards.front: Él no va a conseguir el trabajo, sea quien sea su padre.
cards.back: He's not going to get the job, no matter who his father is.

cards.front: Gane quien gane las elecciones, las cosas no cambiarán.
cards.back: No matter who wins the election, things won't change.

cards.front: Suplique a quien suplique él, no le dan otra oportunidad. Ha quemado sus naves.
cards.back: No matter who he begs, they won't give him another chance. He's burned his bridges.

cards.front: Estoy 100% seguro de que le encontraremos vaya donde vaya.
cards.back: I'm 100% sure we'll find him no matter where he goes.

cards.front: Terminemos donde terminemos, sacaremos el mejor provecho.
cards.back: No matter where we end up, we'll make the best of it.

cards.front: Acabe donde acabe trabajando él, sacará el mejor provecho.
cards.back: No matter where he ends up working, he'll make the best of it.

cards.front: Digas lo que digas, ella no te va a perdonar. (Usa «whatever».)
cards.back: Whatever you say, she isn't going to forgive you.

cards.front: Elijas la que elijas, las cosas saldrán bien.
cards.back: Whichever one you choose, things will work out.

cards.front: Vaya donde vaya y haga lo que haga él, siempre tendrá éxito.
cards.back: Wherever he goes and whatever he does, he'll always succeed.

cards.front: Yo no comparto su punto de vista, pero supongo que es cuestión de opiniones.
cards.back: I don't see it from his point of view but I suppose it's a matter of opinion.

cards.front: No creo que él llegue a entender la magnitud del problema, pero es cuestión de opiniones, supongo.
cards.back: I don't think he comprehends the scale of the problem but it's a matter of opinion I suppose.

cards.front: A él ella le cae muy bien, pero yo no la entiendo en absoluto. Es cuestión de gustos, supongo.
cards.back: He really likes her but I don't get her at all. It's a matter of opinion I suppose.

cards.front: No estoy dispuesta a ceder en este asunto. Es cuestión de principios.
cards.back: I'm not willing to back down on this issue. It's a matter of principle.

cards.front: No estaba dispuesta a olvidar el asunto. Para mí era una cuestión de principios.
cards.back: I was unwilling to let the issue go. It was a matter of principle for me.

cards.front: Digan lo que digan, no cedas. Esto es una cuestión de principios.
cards.back: No matter what they say, don't back down. This is a matter of principle.

cards.front: Él está tomándose estos exámenes como si fueran una cuestión de vida o muerte.
cards.back: He's treating these exams as if they were a matter of life and death.

cards.front: Él está actuando como si conseguir el trabajo fuera una cuestión de vida o muerte.
cards.back: He's acting as if getting the job were a matter of life and death.

cards.front: Tenemos que hacerles llegar la ayuda a tiempo. Para esa gente, es cuestión de vida o muerte.
cards.back: We have to deliver the aid on time. For those people, it's a matter of life and death.

cards.front: Todo el mundo le considera el jefe, pero de hecho sólo es un supervisor.
cards.back: Everyone thinks of him as the boss but as a matter of fact, he's only a supervisor.

cards.front: Supongo que ya le habrás perdonado. La verdad es que no, no le he perdonado. Es cuestión de principios.
cards.back: I suppose you've forgiven him by now. As a matter of fact, no, I haven't. It's a matter of principle.

cards.front: El nuevo dijo que acababa de salir de la cárcel como quien no quiere la cosa.
cards.back: The new guy said he'd just come out of prison in a very matter-of-fact way.

cards.front: La gente se enterará de cómo es él en realidad. Sólo es cuestión de tiempo.
cards.back: It's only a matter of time till people find out what he's really like.

cards.front: La gente se dará cuenta de la magnitud del problema. Sólo es cuestión de tiempo.
cards.back: It's only a matter of time till people realize the scale of the problem.

cards.front: ¿Ya has encontrado otro trabajo? No, no lo he encontrado, pero sólo es cuestión de tiempo.
cards.back: Have you found another job yet? No, I haven't but it's only a matter of time.

cards.front: Me enteré de que al final no conseguiste ese ascenso. ¡No te preocupes!
cards.back: I heard you didn't get that promotion in the end. Never mind!

cards.front: Tengo entendido que el negocio está muy parado ahí en la calle Colbert. ¡Bueno, no importa!
cards.back: I understand business is a bit slow over on Colbert Street. Oh well, never mind!

cards.front: Me enteré de que al final Marie no consiguió el puesto de supervisora. ¡No importa! ¡La próxima vez!
cards.back: I heard Marie didn't get the supervisor position in the end. Never mind! Next time!

cards.front: ¡No te preocupes por Mark! Puede llegar él solo al concierto. Tú puedes venir conmigo.
cards.back: Never mind Mark! He can find his own way to the concert. You can come with me.

cards.front: ¡No te preocupes por Kylie! ¡Que se busque quién la lleve a la fiesta!
cards.back: Never mind Kylie. She can get her own lift to the party.

cards.front: Me enteré de que James te insultó. ¡No te preocupes por él! Pues ahora que vaya al partido él solito.
cards.back: I heard James insulted you. Never mind him! He can find his own way to the game now.

cards.front: No hagas caso a lo que diga Susan. Ella dice muchas tonterías.
cards.back: Never mind what Susan says. She's full of it.

cards.front: No hagas caso a lo que otras personas hagan. ¡Te tienes que decidir tú!
cards.back: Never mind what other people do. You have to make up your own mind!

cards.front: No hagas caso a lo que dice tu jefe. Todo el mundo sabe que dice muchas tonterías.
cards.back: Never mind what your boss says. Everyone knows he's full of it.

cards.front: Tengo un millón de cosas que hacer. ¡Olvídate de eso! Ven a la fiesta conmigo.
cards.back: I have a million things to do. Never mind that! Come to the party with me.

cards.front: Tengo un montón de deberes que hacer. ¡Olvídate de eso! Necesitas una noche libre.
cards.back: I've got heaps of homework to do. Never mind that. You need a night off.

cards.front: Hay tanto trabajo que hacer. ¡Olvídate de eso! Mañana será otro día.
cards.back: There's so much to do. Never mind that. There's always tomorrow.

cards.front: Él habla tan rápido que no le entiendo cuando habla español y menos cuando habla inglés.
cards.back: He speaks so quickly I don't understand him when he speaks Spanish, never mind when he speaks English.

cards.front: No conseguiría un trabajo como supervisor y menos como director.
cards.back: He wouldn't get a job as a supervisor, never mind as a director.

cards.front: El negocio ni siquiera cubrirá gastos este año y mucho menos producirá beneficios.
cards.back: The business won't even break even this year, never mind turn over a profit.

cards.front: No estoy hablando contigo, ¡así que métete en tus propios asuntos!
cards.back: I'm not talking to you, so mind your own business!

cards.front: Si te pregunta él sobre ello otra vez, sólo dile que se meta en sus propios asuntos.
cards.back: If he asks you about it again, just tell him to mind his own business.

cards.front: Quisiera que se metiera en sus propios asuntos. Es una tipa entrometida.
cards.back: I wish she'd mind her own business. She's a nosey so-and-so.

cards.front: ¿Qué hiciste en tu cita de anoche? ¡No es asunto tuyo!
cards.back: What did you get up to on your date last night? None of your business!

cards.front: No es asunto suyo con quién paso mi tiempo fuera del trabajo.
cards.back: It's none of his business who I spend time with outside of work.

cards.front: Quisiera que dejaras el tema. No es asunto tuyo.
cards.back: I wish you'd drop the issue. It's none of your business.

cards.front: No es asunto suyo con quién salgo. No debería haberme preguntado.
cards.back: It isn't any of his business who I date. He shouldn't have asked me.

cards.front: No tengo ningún interés en lo que haces en tu tiempo libre. No es asunto mío.
cards.back: I have no interest in what you get up to in your free time. That isn't any of my business.

cards.front: Quisiera que dejaras de hacerme preguntas sobre la reunión. No es asunto tuyo.
cards.back: I wish you'd stop asking questions about the meeting. It isn't any of your business.

cards.front: ¿Por qué te importa lo que planea hacer él con el dinero? Es asunto suyo, así que déjalo estar.
cards.back: Why do you care what he's planning to do with the money? That's his business so let the issue go.

cards.front: No tengo ningún interés en saber con quién sale Karen. Es asunto suyo.
cards.back: I have absolutely no interest in who Karen's dating. That's her business.

cards.front: Quisiera que dejaras en paz este tema. ¡Es asunto mío!
cards.back: I wish you would let this issue go. It's my business!

cards.front: Sé que has estado haciendo preguntas sobre mi vida privada. No te metas donde no te llaman.
cards.back: I know you've been asking questions about my private life. Keep your nose out of my business.

cards.front: Dile a Jeremy que si no deja de meterse donde no le llaman, habrá consecuencias.
cards.back: Tell Jeremy that if he doesn't keep his nose out of our business, there'll be consequences.

cards.front: Sé que sólo estás intentando ayudar, pero quisiera que no te metieras donde no te llaman.
cards.back: I know you're just trying to help, but I wish you'd keep your nose out of my business.

cards.front: Jonas ha dejado su trabajo bien pagado para ser florista. ¡Está como una cabra!
cards.back: Jonas has given up his high-paid job to become a flower arranger. He's out of his mind!

cards.front: Felicity ha decidido aceptar un trabajo mal pagado en Siberia. ¡Debe de estar como una cabra!
cards.back: Felicity has decided to take a low-paid job in Siberia. She must be out of her mind.

cards.front: He decidido que la única manera de superar el miedo a las alturas es lanzarme en paracaídas. ¡Estás loco!
cards.back: I've decided the only way to get over my fear of heights is to do a sky dive. You're out of your mind!

cards.front: Me voy a volver loco si me hacen quedarme aquí un día más.
cards.back: I'm going to lose my mind if they make me stay here for one more day.

cards.front: No me sorprendería que se volviera loco antes de volver de Siberia.
cards.back: I wouldn't be surprised if he'd lost his mind by the time he gets back from Siberia.

cards.front: No me sorprendería nada que ella se volviera totalmente loca antes de eso.
cards.back: I wouldn't be one bit surprised if she'd lost her mind completely by that time.

cards.front: Lo tiraron a un agujero en Afganistán durante ocho años. No es de extrañar que se volviera loco.
cards.back: They threw him in a hole in Afghanistan for eight years. It's no surprise that he went out of his mind.

cards.front: Su mujer le dejó y su amigo falleció en el mismo mes. No me sorprende que se haya vuelto loco.
cards.back: His wife left and his friend died in the same month. It's hardly a surprise that he went out of his mind.

cards.front: No me sorprende nada que se volviera loco. Ha pasado por muchas cosas.
cards.back: I'm not one bit surprised he went out of his mind. He went through a lot.

cards.front: ¿Dónde has estado hasta ahora? ¡Me he vuelto loca de preocupación!
cards.back: Where have you been until now? I've been going out of my mind with worry!

cards.front: ¡Tenemos un proyecto nuevo! ¡Gracias a Dios! Nos hemos vuelto locos de aburrimiento.
cards.back: We've got a new project! Thank god! We've been going out of our minds with boredom.

cards.front: Lo tiraron a un agujero durante ocho años y casi se volvió loco de soledad.
cards.back: They threw him in a hole for eight years and he almost went out of his mind with loneliness.

cards.front: ¡¿Qué horas son éstas?! ¡Tu madre se ha vuelto loca de preocupación!
cards.back: What time do you call this? Your mother's been going round the bend with worry!

cards.front: ¡Ya era hora de que vinieras! Me he vuelto loco de aburrimiento.
cards.back: It's about time you turned up. I've been going round the bend with boredom.

cards.front: Después de un par de años en el agujero, no es de extrañar que se volviera loco.
cards.back: After a couple of years in the hole, it's hardly a surprise that he went round the bend.
